title: The Moon is slowly leaving
caption: The Moon drifts about 3.8 cm farther from Earth every year.

beats.head: The Moon moves *farther* from Earth every year.
About *three point eight* centimeters a year.
beats.sub: Roughly as fast as your fingernails grow.

beats.head: We measure it with *lasers* and mirrors left up there.
Earth's *tides* slowly nudge it outward.
beats.sub: The Moon pulls on the oceans, and the oceans tug back.

beats.head: Don't worry. It's not *leaving* us.
beats.sub: At this pace, it stays our Moon for billions of years.

beats.head: Distance grows a *little* at a time.
beats.sub: So does closeness. Small check-ins keep you in orbit.

beats.head: Send this to someone you'd *never* drift from.
